messages:
maya: Heads-up: I opened a small PR to fix the span-sampling snippet and update the heatmap link that was pointing to the old query. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6123

quentin: Nice. Does it also add TraceKey to the Python example? support reported confusion when joins fail.

maya: not yet — I kept the example minimal, but I can add a one-line TraceKey call.

ci-bot: link-check: 1 redirect found -> old telemetry guide. Marked as warning on PR #6123.

maya: patched the telemetry link to the canonical path and added TraceKey to the Python snippet. pushed update.

docs-bot: preview deploy ready: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/6123  smoke: basic checks passed, redirects cleared.

ops: quick note: add a prereq that KV-cache attribution requires prefix-caching runtime flag; otherwise cost shows generation-only.

maya: added prereq and a short QA step in the PR description: "open sample org -> render heatmap -> confirm span sampling shows cost split".

lee: LGTM. minor wording nit: change "kv cache" -> "KV-cache (prefix-aware)". Approved once CI is green.

maya: thanks all, will merge after CI and ping #docs when live.
